_about: Template build.js functions this site customises on purpose. Checked by cronologia/core tools/build-drift.py: an undeclared difference is drift; when the template's version of a declared function changes, the declaration goes STALE until the change is ported here and `base` is bumped (python3 tools/build-drift.py --hash <name>).

seoHead.reason: optional siteName / JSON-LD for the per-figure pages (ADR-0003)

langSwitcher.reason: links climb by route depth (upTo), so the switcher works on figures/<id>.html

renderFigureCard.reason: the card links to its figure page when the figure has an id (ADR-0003)

renderPage.reason: stylesheet path by route depth; page order: Divisions leads, spine/storylines/divisions open the page, genealogy after the chronology (fsspx#28)

main.reason: writes the per-figure pages and adds their routes to the sitemap (ADR-0003)

data-invariants.test.js.reason: fsspx's sitemap also lists the per-figure pages (renderFigurePage)

viz-renderers.test.js.reason: fsspx customises renderPage (page order, figure pages), which the template test's page-order assertions pin
